description: SUPERSEDED — use craft/FRAMES.md instead. The base and per-shot specs now live together in a single FRAMES.md file. This file is kept for reference only.

usage.technique: Two-part JSON prompting. Every generation uses the same base prompt verbatim, followed by a shot-specific prompt. This is what keeps all images visually consistent with each other.
usage.base_prompt: Paste assembled_base_prompt first — always verbatim, never rewritten. Do not paraphrase or summarize it.
usage.shot_prompt: After the base prompt, paste the shot's shot_prompt field from frames.json. This contains only what is unique to that shot.
usage.assembled_prompt: The assembled_prompt field in frames.json = assembled_base_prompt + shot_prompt concatenated. This is the ready-to-paste full prompt for the generator.
usage.rule: Base content must never be restated inside a shot_prompt. If a parameter belongs to all shots, it lives here only.

assembled_base_prompt: [Derive this once from all fields below. Lock it. Never rewrite it. This string is pasted verbatim into every generation.]

style.finish: not hyper-clean digital — slightly organic, film-like

lighting.time_of_day: [golden hour / overcast / blue hour — choose one and hold it]
lighting.direction: [raking from the side / filtering from above / etc.]
lighting.temperature: [warm amber / cool silver / etc. — never change mid-project]

color_palette.accent: [used only for the key subject or change moment]
color_palette.sky: [note if sky should be minimal or avoided]
color_palette.avoid: [list the tones and elements to exclude]

world.setting: [the one world this video lives in — establish it and hold it]
world.continuity: every shot belongs to the same world, same time of day

camera.movement: static frame [override per shot in frames.json if needed]

mood: [one phrase — the emotional register that holds across the whole video]
